text:
marie: Quick sync — embargo handover + announcement sequencing for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need final alignment on: embargo windows, SI readiness gating, marketplace listing timing, and driver/firmware patch windows.

sam: timeline ask — do we want single global announce or staggered by region?

marie: prefer staggered. APAC can go later to avoid press clash. looking for +1 on handshake windows.

nvidia_pr: FYI firmware drop for H200 currently targeted mid-June; that may push H200 public announce by ~2 weeks unless we agree to embargo pre-release details.

diego: heads up — MI300 kernel requirement: some customers need 6.1 kernel backports. our canary images pass but must validate SI drivers before GA.

jess: propose three lanes: 1) public announce (press) 2) marketplace listing (images) 3) SI handoff (drivers/docs). each has separate embargo end.

kai: lab capacity is constrained week of June 10-17. If MI300 needs extra soak, push SI handoff to week after or we pull extra infra.

marie: noted. we can't delay press more than 2 weeks. can we do press for H100/H200 then stagger MI300/Gaudi?

nvidia_pr: we can decouple press copy for H100/H200 and mark MI300 as "coming soon" until drivers finalize.

marketplace_ops_bot: reminder: default marketplace embargo policy requires image tags + release notes at least 48h before public listing.

sam: action item: sam to draft a proposed staggered timeline (press date / marketplace date / si-handoff date) and circulate by EOD Thurs.

jess: for SI handoff we should use pre-signed image tags: pattern -> rwinf/<vendor>-<model>-<date>-canary, eg:\n```\nrwinf/nvidia-h200-20240615-canary\n```\nThis prevents accidental GA pull.

diego: also add checksum file and quickstart notes for kernel patches. SI integrators keep hitting mismatched ABI bits.

kai: can we get +2 GPUs into the lab for MI300 soak? ops can try but need approval from infra budget. i'll start request.

marie: If ops can secure the GPUs, we move SI handoff earlier. otherwise we shift MI300 by one week.

jess: propose fallback policy for customers if firmware delay hits: auto-route to H100-compatible variant and append notice in marketplace listing. :thumbsup:

sam: agree. also add a routing/tier note for Redwood Dedicated customers to avoid SLA surprises.

nvidia_pr: noted; we'll try to accelerate firmware sign-off. i'll post a firm commit by Tue. :eyes: 

marie: summary of next steps:
- sam: timeline draft by EOD Thurs (press / marketplace / SI)
- jess: create pre-signed tag naming doc + checklist
- diego: add kernel/driver checklist + checksum procedure to SI repo
- kai: request extra MI300 GPUs from ops (status by EOD Wed)
- nvidia_pr: firm firmware commit by Tue

marie: please react with :thumbsup: once you confirm your action.

sam: 👍

jess: :thumbsup:

diego: +1

kai: working on ops request

nvidia_pr: will update Tue

marketplace_ops_bot: scheduled reminder set for sam (timeline draft) at 2024-06-20 09:00 UTC.
